chiamaka.quote: It was a Sunny Sunday morning 😂
paragraphs: I had previously felt the nudge to actively participate in Youth Fellowship before then so I was very involved in service on that day.
I was slated to take announcements and decided to add my usual touch and spunk to it, whatever could add life to the every Sunday routine.
And so I did.
But whilst taking it, I saw a young radiant bright face smiling at me (not the usual look to spot in my local Church at the time)
So he stood out quite easily
"Why is this guy smiling at me?", I thought to myself whilst continuing on with the announcement I was giving.
Once that was done, and the Church service was over, Youths - as announced - were urged to wait at the side of the Church for a brief meeting.
Well… Well...
Guess who came to stay by me at that side of the Church?, exactly.. That radiant face.
That person introduced himself and asked for my name, complimented my session and even asked if I was a Pastor's kid (He was one).
I wondered out loud as to who invited him, and he said nobody…
I found him confusing initially, so he was getting a lot of 'side eye' from me.
The Church meeting was over, we stepped out of the building together and continued our small talk.
Hmm...

Even though I had never seen this face before, whilst standing under the hot sun with my black turban, black turtle neck, black long skirt and jacket on (with no jewelries - just a wristwatch), I felt like I knew him.
My soul knew that man from the very first day we had a conversation.
He just felt familiar to me.
Whilst still speaking with me, my Mum had just walked past us and given me "the look" to wrap it up. 😂😂
Me knowing that it would end in asking for my number las last, hurriedly gave him in my bid to fast forward the conversation.
This was our first meeting point.
Many weeks past…
And Bambam remained unread in my DM.
He texted on the Sunday we met and subsequently responded to my WhatsApp status but unread he remained.

Until that Wednesday in May of 2024, I was just coming back home from a friend's store right along my street when I saw one guy, walking on the opposite side of the small street road, with some boyfriend jeans, a black shirt, black beanie and a bounce to his steps.
No man had ever looked that finee 😂
It was as if my eyes were suddenly opened and I felt the handsomeness aura from where I was - across the street.
We spoke casually…

He had come on time for a Youth meeting holding that day and met the gates locked. He asked me a few questions about it that I can't fully recall at the moment; because right there and then I purposed in my heart to pull him from the deep sea of unread messages into land. He looked sooo fine to me! 😁
Umm…
Ladies and Gentle readers, that day yh…?
The 22nd of May in the year 2024, we begun talking and never stopped.
A month and a week later, he proposed on a call (cause Bambam doesn't believe in "girlfriend" thing), I got an unofficial proposal that begun our relationship as official best friends together.
Bambam witnessed many milestones of mine from then and I did of his.
We bonded over the concepts of Kingdom and Purpose, decided to continually learn and grow together.
We may have faced many hurdles in between but our Story is proof that God literally writes the best love stories.
Now here we are.. Myself and Bambam my best friend.
God has kept us, strengthened and grown the roots of our conviction for each other.
Not sure how to end this story draft.
All that's left to say is Thank you Lord.
I love you Father and I'm grateful for my Bambam!! 😊
I look forward to doing life, purpose and fulfilling our Kingdom assignments alongside you.
No matter  how hard life gets, having you to make me laugh along the way definitely helps.
Having the melodies and rhythms of your sound eases my hearts even during the difficult moments
And having your protective side always ready to defend and protect me has been such a charming experience for me.
A lifetime of your rich love is causing my heart excitement in anticipation for our journey to officially begin!
I’m wondering how to squeeze our story into a short article and it’s not even easy.

22nd March 2024, I had just moved from Bayelsa state, left everything I was building, left my house, gave out my pots, gas and most properties to move in with my grandparents in rivers state. It felt like my life was falling apart, but I knew God said to leave.

It was my second time attending that local church (April 21), a youth Sunday. I really wasn’t comfortable because the church had more older people and children than youths. It was time for announcement and this fair young lady came up, she carried an energy that changed the atmosphere of the entire auditorium. The children were responding with shouts. I really didn’t know when I started smiling at her, I was pleased.
After service, they had a general youth meeting and I joined in, she came and sat beside me and of course I engaged her in a conversation. 😁

Hi, you did really amazing up there. You carried the whole church like you’ve been doing it all your life. “Are you the pastor’s child?” I asked. With a mild smile she responded, “No I’m not. I just love to put in my best whenever I get the chance”
We exchanged names and contact before we left the gate that day.
This girl kept on snubbing me, Mehhhn!!! 😂. I texted, responded to her status, showed interest but the best she did was react to my messages.

Fast forward to May 22nd, she texted me that evening after we saw ourselves on the road by the church. We were supposed to have a youth meeting in church that day but I came out to meet the gate locked and went back home after our brief chat. I made her go for the youth (so she said😂) that I didn’t attend.

Since then, it has been a really closely knitted friendship. She was the first friend I made as I moved. I was still healing from the total heartbreak of ending a relationship God disapproved of. I cried for hours everyday and I wasn’t even thinking of another relationship, but this very nice lady always had questions to ask and faith based conversations to initiate.
In no time I started recalling the prophecies that had gone ahead of me about a fair tall lady, dreams I started having and coincidences I honestly cannot explain.
I knew it like I knew my God given assignment on earth that this would be the woman I will do life and purpose with.
Side note: We were 20 and 21 year olds at the time. 😂

June 29th 2024, few minutes past 2 AM whilst on a video call, I asked Chi to marry me. We had just prayed on the call about an issue that bothered us both, I was in tears when it was confirmed to me again that this was it for me. I popped the question, she said yes and that’s when and how we started dating officially. It was easier for me to go that “marry me” route because I already knew she had her own convictions and I’ve never really liked the idea oh a “girlfriend”.
Things with us happened so fast😂
Since then it had been learning, misunderstandings, forgiving and growing for us.
We moved to CCI together September 2025. She left a month before me because I was zonal admin at our church at the time and needed to resign and handover properly.

February 14th (Valentine’s day) this year, I proposed to the absolute love of my life in Church with more than 3,000 youths present at our annual Young and Free Conference. (That’s a whole different story altogether)
Today, I’m writing this story as the soon to be husband to this priceless pearl that I would spend everything I have to purchase a field just to lay hold of.
This absolute proof of God’s mercy and intentionality towards me.
This woman that God has used to grow me into a man quickly than I would have anticipated.
Here’s to the beginning of a lifetime and a day extra of loving and serving one of God’s most lovely daughters.
Oh Chim! 🤧
This is love ohh, believe me, it is!
